name: ds_pet
description: ds_pet: a desktop pet for macOS — a remix of PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet. 住在 macOS 桌面上的蓝毛小女仆（基于 dsh-pet 二次创作）

scripts.dist:all: bash scripts/build-mac.sh --dmg --arch arm64 && bash scripts/build-mac.sh --dmg --arch x64
scripts.check: for f in desktop/main/*.js desktop/pet/*.js desktop/chat/*.js desktop/settings/*.js desktop/i18n/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
